zh: 推理等级滑杆的方向在档位未按强度排列的模型上不再反向：Qoder、Raccoon 与 MiniMax 的档位由供应商按自己的顺序下发（Qoder 的 Qwen3.8-Max 是「极高、低、中、关闭思考」），而滑杆把下发顺序当作强度轴，于是最右端落在最弱的档位上——在这些模型上停止思考被读成了最强。现在档位按强度重新排列后再画，无法判定强度的档位保持供应商顺序并排在已知档位之后。
en: The effort slider no longer runs the wrong way on models whose levels arrive unordered: Qoder, Raccoon and MiniMax send their levels in the provider's own order (Qoder's Qwen3.8-Max sends xhigh, low, medium, none), and the slider read that order as a strength scale, so the right end landed on the weakest level — on these models switching thinking off read as the strongest setting. The levels are now ordered by strength before the ladder is drawn, and a level whose strength is unknown keeps the provider order and follows every known level.
